body: The ground trembled slightly beneath me as the heavy weight descended towards the dirt road below. The air around me felt thick with tension, each breath an effort against the impending impact. With a deep, steadying breath, I stepped forward into the open area where my friends gathered. Their eyes met mine in silent agreement, all hands raised in a supportive gesture.
full:
The ground trembled slightly beneath me as the heavy weight descended towards the dirt road below. The air around me felt thick with tension, each breath an effort against the impending impact. With a deep, steadying breath, I stepped forward into the open area where my friends gathered. Their eyes met mine in silent agreement, all hands raised in a supportive gesture.
